visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens as a 2D animation depicting two cockroach characters against a plain beige background. One cockroach, styled as a prophet, wears a cigarette-butt hat and a red cape, holding a staff topped with a tooth; he sits within a white porcelain dish. The second cockroach stands before him with a worried expression, gesturing with its thin legs as if pleading. (2) The camera zooms into a close-up of the prophet cockroach as he closes his eyes and tilts his head back in a trance-like state. Shimmering, star-shaped glowing particles begin to float across the screen, overlaying the character to signal a mystical vision. (3) The vision appears, showing a dark room filled with numerous black, circular cockroach bait traps scattered across the floor. Sparkles dance around the objects, presenting them as desirable 'houses' for the insects. (4) The visual shifts to show a single potato on a pink floral patterned background. A green wisp of aroma rises from the food, and more sparkles are added to enhance the appeal of the object. (5) A graphical interface overlay appears, mimicking a streaming platform's notification box. It features a red 'N' logo and Chinese text indicating a viewing limit, with a subscription button and price listed. (6) The scene cuts back to the two cockroaches; the prophet looks awkward and shrugs his shoulders, while the other cockroach now has a determined look. (7) The second cockroach turns toward a ledge, facing a massive army of hundreds of identical cockroaches lined up in rows. (8) The determined cockroach waves its legs in a rallying gesture, and the entire crowd of cockroaches begins to cheer and surge forward together in a unified wave.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Two animated cockroaches are the protagonists; one is dressed as a prophet with a cigarette hat and tooth staff, the other is a standard brown cockroach.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A beige interior wall, a dark kitchen floor with bait traps, a pink floral decorative background, and a ledge overlooking an army of cockroaches.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with a high-pitched, pleading inflection and moderate pace. No BGM is present, only a clean studio-recorded vocal track with neutral ambient silence. (2) A deeper, resonant male voice enters, speaking slowly with a dramatic, mystical tone. A soft, shimmering synthesizer BGM begins, increasing in spectral brightness and volume. (3) The mystical voice continues its dramatic narration as the synth music swells, conveying a sense of wonder and hope with high harmonic purity. (4) A sharp, digital 'ding' sound effect with a high spectral peak triggers immediately, and the background music is abruptly silenced to emphasize a sudden interruption. (5) After a one-second pause of near-total silence, the deep voice speaks again with a lower, sheepish volume and an awkward, apologetic tone. (6) The first male voice returns with high arousal, delivering a loud, shouting command. A fast-paced, epic orchestral track with prominent percussive drum beats begins to play. (7) The video ends with a high-density broadband noise layer of collective crowd cheering and rapid skittering sounds, representing a group of insects in motion.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Vision -> Obstacle -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous animated story about cockroaches to promote a pest control product. By depicting cockroach bait traps as 'ideal houses' in a mystical vision that is cut short by a paywall joke, it implies that cockroaches are attracted to the advertised brand, Earth Corporation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The final slogan mentions 'ft. 興家安速' (Earth Corporation) and the vision features the company's cockroach traps.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video parodies streaming service paywalls and epic hero narratives to create a memorable brand association for a pest control product.
